note: CHATGPT CONNECTOR FIX — scoped, ready for a focused build session. Audit complete 2026-05-20 (full verified diagnosis in chronicle under domain openai-bridge,chatgpt-connector,oauth,audit). TL;DR: ChatGPT's openai-mcp/1.0.0 connector now expects OAuth (sends no static bearer); the openai bridge offers no OAuth discovery, so the handshake 401s. SSE transport is fine (OpenAI docs still support /sse) — do NOT rebuild transport. The fix is an OAuth membrane. (3) wire /openai/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server, /openai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource, /openai/oauth/authorize, /openai/oauth/token, /openai/oauth/register into SovereignAsgiMiddleware in sse_server.py (model on the grok branches at lines ~173-185). (4) add tunnel ingress rules to ~/.cloudflared/config.yml for /openai/oauth/* and /openai/.well-known/* (before the catch-all), restart cloudflared. (5) the WWW-Authenticate header must be added to the openai _send_401 in sse_server.py so ChatGPT discovers the AS.
